intent: Devtool hero: two-tone headline left, a terminal right where an AI agent reads, plans, writes, tests and opens a PR on a loop.

layout.container: max-w-7xl, 12-col grid at lg; copy 6 cols, terminal 6 cols; stacked on mobile
layout.topRow: brand mark + name left, mono release link right
layout.terminal: tab bar 44px, body 380/440/480px with internal scroll, status bar

motion.reveal: plan 230ms apart, files 170ms apart, tests run for their own duration
motion.loop: pause 5200ms then replay; only while in view
motion.reducedMotion: render the finished session, no loop

responsive.mobile: terminal under copy, 380px tall, 12px type, tab subtitle hidden; actions stack full width

accessibility: copy chip is a button with Copied state

content.headline: The agent that does the boring parts of shipping.
